I’m Abir Outaleb, a clinical psychologist.

My work rests on a simple belief: people think and heal best when they feel truly heard. I bring structured, evidence-based methods into a warm and unhurried room, so therapy feels like a shared project rather than a verdict.

I work with adults facing anxiety, low mood and life transitions, with young people, and with families navigating developmental and behavioral needs.

  • Clinical psychologist, Cabinet Al Wissal
  • Trained in cognitive behavioral therapy (TCC)
  • Training in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA)
  • Psychological assessment for children and adults
Change rarely arrives all at once. It arrives in small, repeated moments of courage.

Care that grows with you.

Warm, structured and unhurried, from the first conversation to the last.

Therapies, chosen with you.

Every plan starts with understanding what you need. These are the approaches I use most often.

Cognitive behavioral therapy (TCC)

For anxiety, low mood, panic, obsessive thoughts and everyday stress. Structured, practical and focused on change you can feel.

We look at the thoughts and habits that keep you stuck, test them against real life and build new responses one step at a time. You leave each session with something to try.

Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA)

Individual programs for children and adolescents on the autism spectrum or with developmental needs.

We begin with a careful assessment, then build a plan around your child’s strengths. Learning happens through play and daily routines, and parents are involved at every stage.

Parent guidance

Support for families facing challenges with behavior, sleep, school, routines or big emotions.

Clear, practical strategies shared at a pace that fits your family, so you feel more confident and less alone in the day-to-day.

Psychological assessment

Thorough evaluations for children and adults, with feedback explained in plain language.

Structured interviews and standardized tools, followed by a clear written report and a conversation about what happens next.

A plan that fits your life.

Every approach is adjusted to your pace, your family and your goals.

  1. Reach out

    Send a message or choose a time that suits you.

  2. Consultation

    We talk through what is happening, what you hope for and whether we are a good match.

  3. A plan together

    We agree on an approach, a rhythm and a way to notice progress.
